_comment: Shaped like the cluster policy the platform team applies to Databricks job clusters.
Nothing in this repository reads it: etlduck runs in one local process against a DuckDB
file. It is here because the constraints it encodes are the ones the pipeline is written
to respect, and because a reviewer should be able to see them.
See src/etlduck/spark_compat.py for what is and is not real.

num_workers._comment: 0 means a single-node cluster, which is what this workload actually needs.

_comment: Fixed, not defaulted. Every timestamp in this warehouse is a UTC instant and every
date is derived from one. A cluster configured to a local zone would bucket a slice of
events into the wrong day -- measured at 58 of 400 rows in the sample data.

spark_conf.spark.sql.ansi.enabled._comment: Overflow and bad casts must raise rather than return NULL.
